purpose: Train and test post-trigger recovery separately from nominal room behavior. Use only exact first-trigger teacher spans, terminating when Link has moved at least 16 pixels from the trigger state; do not mix these labels into the broad policy until the recovery skill passes its own gate.
recovery_start: first state-checked y80/y83/y84 trigger before any guided action
recovery_success: Link moves at least 16 Manhattan pixels from the trigger state, remains alive, leaves the original blocked region, and does not return to the same stationary y80/y83/y84 stall within the post-escape horizon
integration: Not authorized. A recovery-skill gate must pass before any autonomous-policy integration experiment is frozen.
